name: Savannah
tagline: Shady squares draped in Spanish moss
summary: Savannah is a beautifully preserved Southern city laid out around 22 leafy squares. Walk under moss-draped live oaks to Forsyth Park's fountain, tour antebellum mansions, stroll River Street and visit Bonaventure Cemetery.
seasonNote: Spring is lovely with azaleas; St Patrick's Day is huge. Summers are hot.
arrival: Savannah/Hilton Head Airport is 20 minutes away.
gettingAround: Walk the squares; free DOT shuttle.
cashTip: Cards and tap work almost everywhere. Tip 18-22% at restaurants and a dollar or two per drink at bars.
foodTip: Fried chicken, pralines and Lowcountry boil.
buyTip: Pralines and local art from SCAD.
